label: Source concrete coverage and causal head versus actual graph ancestry
term: source concrete coverage and causal head versus actual graph ancestry
resolution: A2P1 uses cause-or-effect capability, while A2c uses cause capability alone; do not silently carry its reported denial across that narrowing. Source entire-chain member closure is not collective causation. The existing actualGraph ranges over actual Ontic candidates and its sources exclude incoming causes from actual nodes only. Its finite ancestor cones allow branching, cycles and self-loops and its sources need not cause anything else. Matching those meanings, actual causal endpoint guards and objective modal scope requires explicit application interfaces. The source existential N-to-Box-N stipulation does not itself identify one rigid individual across worlds. A2P2c/A2c3 additionally changes the necessity/contingency classification and remains a separate pending extraction, not an alias for NecessaryAt. Declaration-completion audit 2026-11-09: senses _1 and _2 remain unresolved pending owner selection of possible exercise, unexercised disposition, or explicit sibling interpretations. No lean_declaration is assigned and both allowances remain. Conditional primitive-relation controls in TruthCore.Causality.SurveyCapabilityControls do not finish either meaning. PossibleCauseAt supplies a candidate rigid accessible-world exercise reading only; endpoint existence and world/individual scope remain explicit choices. Composite sense _3 is unchanged. The causal and ordered no-first siblings are separate senses of NO_FIRST_MEMBER (disambiguation baa39012-a3d1-4d41-a94a-6b0a414c2196); neither is a conjunctive mapping or replacement of original composite sense _3, whose applicability and coverage remain OPEN. Owner has since approved exploring BOTH profiles. The new SurveyCapabilityProfiles batch certifies conditional analyst alternatives with guards, productive trials, masking/finks and explicit bridge omissions; it does not identify a selected profile with either original sense. Owner selection is no longer a prerequisite to this exploration. Original senses and all allowances are retained; source application, coverage and root bridges remain OPEN. Analyst capability siblings 6 and 7 register guarded accessible exercise and productive trial disposition respectively. They use distinct declaration-backed relations. Outgoing and incoming-or-outgoing domains are constructed from each selected relation; neither is substituted for the original cause-capable or cause-or-effect meanings. The comparison certificate contains two conditional passages: disposition to exercise requires Realization, and exercise to disposition requires Attribution. Omission models refute both unconditional passages. Original source mapping, modal/endpoint scope and actualGraph application remain OPEN. These alternatives do not select one original interpretation or imply philosophical exhaustiveness.
